title: pp.fft-block-st~
description: `pp.fft-block-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.fft-block~`, passing left and right signal inputs to corresponding delayed signal outputs for FFT-block latency compensation. Its FFT block size and overlap can be set by creation arguments (defaults: 1024 and 4) or with `blocksize` and `overlap` messages, and it can save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
